sections.title: Discover Afghanistan consciously
sections.body: Afghanistan has historical heritage, diverse nature and rich local cultures. Determine the destination, season, route and accommodation before departure and respect the culture, environment and safety recommendations of each region.
items: Check the road and weather conditions
Bring the necessary documents and equipment with you
Avoid unplanned trips in unfamiliar areas
